description:
Goal

Make CallableConstructionOwner::construction the exact authority for one owned first-class wrapper construction. Direct-only callable producers expose None; first-class producers expose a nonempty Some that root packaging consumes without reconstructing eligibility.

Proven signal

A direct lambda producer previously exposed construction=Some with zero members, Absent carrier, exact direct edges, and no boundary publications. The producer derived direct_edges and first_class_edges separately but unconditionally minted construction afterward. Escaped, opaque-call argument, captured, mixed, and uncalled named-reference controls already carry nonempty first_class_edges and exact nonempty constructions.

Strategy

Use the settled upstream first_class_edges at the local position producer as the construction ownership decision. Preserve direct callable layout and facts independently. Delete the downstream BackendCallableConstruction projection, dead construction builder inventory, publication-boundary eligibility join, and empty-member arity fallback. Package positioned owners with construction=Some directly; do not infer eligibility from layouts, types, targets, carriers, or root inventories.

Acceptance

Direct-only owners expose construction=None and create no wrapper. First-class local producer owners expose exact nonempty constructions and create wrappers without a second eligibility filter. Preserve uncalled named refs, escaped/opaque/captured/mixed callable behavior, replacement/order/retraction semantics, interpreter/JIT/AOT, the full library suite, strict clippy/fmt/diff gates, and release direct/public controls.
title: Clarify callable construction as first-class wrapper authority
